description: Verse code review, closer read: the instant checks plus an AI reviewer that confirms real findings, drops wrong ones and adds what patterns miss. One call, one review. Costs 0.05 USDC on Base (eip155:8453) per call, paid with x402 over MCP: call it without payment to get the PaymentRequired terms in structuredContent, then call it again with the signed PaymentPayload in params._meta["x402/payment"]. The settlement comes back in result._meta["x402/payment-response"]. A call that cannot be done (bad input, the service busy) is never charged. The same service over HTTP: POST https://a-to-mind.com/api/x402/review.
